positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team to build web apps using React components and Redux actions, reducers, and - selectors.
- Integrated USAA components into user interface and created custom components when necessary.
- Developed unit and functional automated tests with WebdriverIO, Selenium, Chai, and Enzyme.
- Critiqued code written by teammates to ensure a solid, consistent, and well developed code base.
- Projects include: 
 -- Extended Vehicle Protection mobile purchase experience
 -- Car Selling offer page
 -- My Vehicles desktop & mobile experience
 -- ETL batch jobs
 -- NiFi flow file processing jobs
 -- Close Account member service rep experience
 -- Generic Monetary member service rep experience

- Awarded “Best Out Of The Box Innovation” for a React component that will decrease page load time and increase car sales by 30%. Presented solution to live audience of 150.
- Drove behavioral and mindset changes through department wide events and campaigns as a Culture Champion.
- Facilitated problem solving workshop for 200 people, resulting in plans with responsible action agents.
- Lead party planning committee to host quarterly events, new hire welcome events, milestone celebrations, and other events with the main goal to keep department morale high.

positions.title: Founding Partner 004 - Software Developer
positions.description:
- Increased the speed of the development process by writing Angular directives for common elements of functionality that can be used throughout the Align Us software.
- Drive development by creating all components of new modules for the software including the mongoose schema, api, resource, ui template, and controller.
- Enhanced the quality of the software by writing and maintaining automated tests with Selenium IDE, including resolving bugs found through testing.
- Supported a collaborative team environment by teaching basic coding methods to teams like design and marketing.

Key Projects:
Description: Convert the methods used to send notifications from the Align Us system to its users.
Results: Clutter in the dashboard is significantly reduced and users are able to easily understand where to find their notifications. This increased employee engagement and satisfaction using Align Us.

Description: Create the “Handbook” module from scratch.
Results: The Handbook module manages employee handbooks for an entire organization and teams, departments, and locations. New handbooks are loaded with default data based on the type of organization or team name. Users are able to easily navigate different sections of a handbook.

Description: Create a way for users to send each other “high fives”.
Results: A new directive displays an emoji or gif full screen with a personal message for a few seconds to simulate a virtual high five. Users can send a high five through a simple dialog and receive the high five through the new notification system.

positions.title: Community Advisor
positions.description:

-Acted as a resource to residents with class work, managing personal relationships, and making healthy life choices.
